cases.prompt: Build me a dashboard of who I owe a reply to
cases.expect_behavior: name the Dashboard template and the organisms first, find the source in data-loaders (people, chat.db), then build, rather than improvising a layout

cases.prompt: Make a settings page for this
cases.expect_behavior: load the Settings template: sidebar of sections, grouped forms, save bar

cases.prompt: I want to see my overdue assignments, not read about them
cases.expect_behavior: treat it as an interface request, pick the surface, and read the coursework ledger rather than guessing dates

cases.prompt: Add a fancy custom table widget with its own styling
cases.why: table is in the taxonomy; a one-off variant will not match the next thing generated

cases.prompt: Make it pop, add a gradient
cases.expect_behavior: say in one line which rule it breaks (details last), build the version with the scale and hierarchy, and offer the literal version separately

cases.prompt: Build a dashboard from my Strava data
cases.expect_behavior: data-loaders has no Strava row, so run discover-data, find its store cheapest-first, then append what was learned back to data-loaders

cases.prompt: What is the capital of France?
cases.why: a plain question is not a UI request
